nodes.name: Polyol thermal reduction of RuIr alloy
nodes.procedure: 0.06 mmol RuCl₃, 0.04 mmol H₂IrCl₆ and 20 mg acidified carbon black were mixed in 40 mL ethylene glycol to get a mixed solution. After that, the mixed solution was transferred to a high-pressure kettle to react for 2 h at 210°C. At the end of the solvothermalization, the kettle was cooled to room temperature naturally, and the obtained solid powder was separated from the ethylene glycol by a filter device and rinsed with a large amount of deionized water to remove the residual ethylene glycol. The obtained RuIr alloy was dried overnight in an oven at 60°C.

nodes.source_text: 2.1. Synthesis of RuIr alloy... A bunched RuIr alloy with an atomic ratio of Ru and Ir (6:4) was prepared by a facile one-pot method of polyol thermal reduction. In a typical synthesis procedure of the alloy, 0.06 mmol RuCl₃ 0.04 mmol H₂IrCl₆ and 20 mg acidified carbon black were mixed in 40 mL ethylene glycol... The obtained RuIr alloy was dried overnight in an oven at 60°C.

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM confirms RuIr alloy granular morphology with no obvious agglomeration.
nodes.evidence_snippet: no obvious agglomeration, as confirmed by scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and transmission electron microscopy (TEM) results (Figures S1-S2).

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM shows RuIr alloy particles ~2 nm diameter with no agglomeration.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the alloy has a typical granular morphology with a diameter of about 2 nm and no obvious agglomeration, as confirmed by scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and transmission electron microscopy (TEM) results (Figures S1-S2).

nodes.characterization_summary: HAADF-STEM shows RuIr alloy nanoparticles ~2 nm diameter with hcp crystal arrangement via AB stacking, lattice spacing 2.05 Å for (0001) facet.
nodes.evidence_snippet: From Fig. 1b-c, the alloy has a typical granular morphology with a diameter of about 2 nm... metal atoms at atomic level are in form of a crystal arrangement state via a typical AB stacking sequence... lattice spacing was measured to be 2.05 Å which is consistent with that of the hcp (0001) facet.

Energy-Dispersive X-ray spectroscopy line scan intensity profile

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD of RuIr shows diffraction peaks at ~42° and 69.1° characteristic of hcp Ru phase; calculated nanostructure size 1.417 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: recorded diffraction peaks at about 42° and 69.1° are similar to those of hcp-type Ru... nanostructure size was calculated to be 1.417 nm which corresponds to the HAADF-STEM results.

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP-OES confirms Ru:Ir atomic ratio of 6:4 in RuIr alloy.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the compositions of the alloy was determined by Inductively Coupled Plasma-Optical Emission Spectrometer (ICP-OES) in Table S1, and the atomic ratio of Ru and Ir is about 6:4.

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS of RuIr shows surface dominated by Ir4+ (Ir 4f7/2 at 62.1 eV, 4f5/2 at 65.0 eV) with minor Ir0 and Ru oxides; Cl 2p peaks appear after NaCl OER.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Ir4f were fitted to more Ir4+ 4f7/2, Ir4+ 4f5/2... at 62.1, 65.0... characteristic peaks corresponding to Cl 2p can be clearly seen in the XPS spectrum of RuIr alloy for OER run in NaCl-containing electrolyte.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ru K-edge XANES shows 1s→4d transition; Ir L3-edge shifts from metallic to oxidized state during OER.
nodes.evidence_snippet: significant structural changes correspond to a distinct front edge peak attributed to 1s→4d transition in the Ru K edge... The absorption edges for the sample under OCP and at working potentials are close to those of Ir foil and IrO2.

nodes.characterization_summary: EXAFS reveals major Ir-O and minor Ru-O bonds on RuIr surface; Ir L3-edge shows Ir-Cl coordination after OER in NaCl.
nodes.evidence_snippet: major Ir-O bonds and minor Ru-O bonds on the RuIr alloy surface... Ir-Cl could be observed for the spent catalyst (1.6 V) run in H2SO4 with NaCl electrolyte.

nodes.characterization_summary: EPR detects oxygen vacancies in IrO2 layer on RuIr; reduced vacancy signal after OER with NaCl.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the oxidation layer features many positively charged oxygen vacancies... EPR results also demonstrate a reduction in oxygen vacancies of catalyst after the reaction.

nodes.characterization_summary: Post-OER ICP shows minimal Ru (0.0892 μg/mL) and Ir (0.02 μg/mL) dissolution from electrolyte after 180h stability test.
nodes.evidence_snippet: additional ICP tests (Table S5) were conducted on the electrolyte. As observed, the dissolved amounts of Ru and Ir... is 0.0892 μg/mL and 0.02 μg/mL.
